verdict.rationale: The Apple M4 Pro is a hardware system-on-chip, not a networked service, so a downloadable OpenAPI-style spec for it is a category error. The pack's Metal, Core ML and MLX items describe developer frameworks that run on the chip, not a machine-readable API spec for the product. The llms.txt 404 probe concerns Apple's developer site, not the chip.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
